text:
NOTE
**Still not ready — commits aren't cleaned up and the checklist isn't the template's**

New: The author added a regression test case to the Markdown fixtures file. Missing: the history still has "Fixes #17419" and "fixed linting error to pass CI" as separate commits, with the test in its own commit (which also names the wrong issue, 17418). The self-review checklist is a custom list, not the one from the PR template.

###### Next step

Keep "not ready" and have laurynmm (who gave the feedback) point the author to the commit discipline guide.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for adding the test! Please squash the fix, lint fix, and test into a single commit with a message that follows our [commit discipline guide](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/commit-discipline.html), and replace your custom checklist with the self-review checklist from the PR template. It's also worth moving the before/after screenshots into the PR description.
```
